newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Olympic Financial raised by Kinnard.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Olympic Financial raised by Kinnard.

text.p: -- John G. Kinnard & Co said Tuesday it raised Olympic Financial Ltd to buy from accumulate, citing price weakness in the stock after an Oppenheimer & Co recommendation to sell the stock.
-- While saying it did not have a chance to read the entire Oppenheimer report, Kinnard said it believes Olympic's fundamental story remains intact despite the report.
-- Kinnard also said Olympic's new chief executive officer, Rich Greenawalt, will be paid 75 percent less than his predecessor in salary, while receiving about one million equity options.
-- "We view the compensation package as a positive attempt to align compensation directly with the shareholders," analyst Robert Evans wrote in a research note.
-- Olympic shares were down 2-1/2 to 12-1/8 Tuesday.
